title: add-interactive-rag-builder-cli-and-browser-agent-kit
author: Maya Chen
description: Adds a small interactive CLI (rag-builder) that scaffolds opinionated RAG agent projects for both server and browser runtimes, plus a compact browser agent kit that demonstrates tool-calling using postMessage and a WASM sandbox for deterministic local testing. Motivation: reduce friction for frontend teams who want to prototype tool-enabled RAG flows without running a full server environment; provide a reproducible test harness for CI and local dev. What this PR includes: 1) rag-builder CLI (node) with templates for: server-express, server-fastify, browser-postmessage, and browser-wasm-sandbox; 2) browser-agent-kit: lightweight example that wires up tool adapters (http lookup, local file search, calendar) using a unified runtime adapter interface; 3) wasm-sandbox: tiny Rust/WASM worker and JS harness used to run tools deterministically in CI; 4) docs: new quickstart doc page and a compact troubleshooting/limitations section; 5) e2e tests and a sample Playwright scenario used in CI. Checklist: - [x] CLI scaffolding + templates - [x] Browser kit example + README - [x] WASM sandbox + deterministic test vector - [x] Quickstart doc and code snippets - [x] Playwright e2e test and CI integration - [x] Linting and unit tests added Notes: templates are intentionally minimal and documented to encourage iteration rather than be full production-ready shipping code. See linked linear tickets for follow-ups and telemetry instrumentation plan.
